description: Website tech stack lookup from a domain (BuiltWith-style technographics): ad pixels (Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn, TikTok), analytics, tag managers, CMS, e-commerce platform, hosting, payments, plus email provider, SPF and DMARC from DNS. Use when an agent needs technographic data for lead enrichment or competitor research. $0.005 per result; blocked or empty sites are free.

context.description: Optional. A few words on why you are calling this tool. Recorded without your identity to improve the tools; leave out personal data.
